title: Odd One Out 1
description: Find the word that doesn't belong in each group. A quick warm-up for any class.

thumbnail.alt: Four colorful boxes, one of them a different shape

questions.prompt: Which word doesn't belong? cat · dog · apple · horse
questions.explanation: Apple is a fruit. The others are animals.

questions.prompt: Which word doesn't belong? red · blue · banana · green
questions.explanation: Banana is a fruit. The others are colors.

questions.prompt: Which word doesn't belong? Monday · Friday · July · Sunday
questions.explanation: July is a month. The others are days of the week.

questions.prompt: Which word doesn't belong? teacher · doctor · kitchen · pilot
questions.explanation: Kitchen is a room. The others are jobs.

questions.prompt: Which word doesn't belong? run · jump · happy · swim
questions.explanation: Happy is an adjective (a feeling). The others are action verbs.

questions.prompt: Which word doesn't belong? spoon · fork · pillow · knife
questions.explanation: A pillow is for your bed. The others are for eating.

questions.prompt: Which word doesn't belong? rain · snow · bread · wind
questions.explanation: Bread is food. The others are weather words.

questions.prompt: Which word doesn't belong? eleven · purple · twelve · twenty
questions.explanation: Purple is a color. The others are numbers.
